name: infojobs-mcp
description: InfoJobs (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_infojobs_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INFOJOBS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_infojobs_client_id.description: Client ID of an application registered at https://developer.infojobs.net/ ('App authentication is done via HTTP basic access authentication' with Client ID and Client secret).

platform_mcp_infojobs_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INFOJOBS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_infojobs_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same InfoJobs application.

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /api/9/offer (User role public, no scope): q keyword, page (the example answers currentPage 1), maxResults (default 20; 'We strongly recommend limiting to 50 or fewer'). province/city/country take dictionary keys (/dictionary/*), so location/country are not sent. salaryMin/salaryMax are dictionary items ({id, value} text), left in raw; the list hit has no full description (requirementMin in raw).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /api/7/offer/{offerId} (User role public). minPay/maxPay are Pay objects and stay in raw; externalUrlForm, when set, is where the application must be made.
